note: Wyoming's 20 no_catalog rows (19 campgrounds; Bennett Peak is listed twice; Kaler Hollow is really in Utah). 7 added, 13 excluded. Most rows are small BLM river and byway camps whose RIDB descriptions state RV parking or pull-throughs outright, which settled inclusion without a length.

added.name: Bennett Peak Campground (North Platte River, BLM)
added.caveat: well out of service; ~20 miles of rough gravel

added.name: Chalk Bluffs Campground (North Platte River, BLM)
Grave Springs Campground (South Bighorn/Red Wall Byway)
Sweetwater Bridge Campground (Wind River Front, BLM)

excluded.name: Bennett Creek Campground
excluded.why: the same campground as Bennett Peak (202226), added as 13300

excluded.name: Blucher Creek Campground
excluded.why: an ADA site with a shade structure at the end of 22 miles of county and BLM roads; no site count or vehicle size given anywhere

excluded.name: Bobcat-Houlihan Campground
excluded.why: a trailhead with horse-trailer parking and hitching rails

excluded.name: Buffalo Creek Campground (Red Wall byway)
excluded.why: four sites; can only handle small RVs

excluded.name: Cottonwood Creek Campground (Bighorn Lake)
excluded.why: trailhead camp with horse corrals and a watering trough for an advanced-rider trail; no size evidence

excluded.name: Dutch Joe Campground
excluded.why: undeveloped area behind a low-water creek crossing

excluded.name: Golden Currant Campground
excluded.why: 'overnight use is restricted to tent camping only'

excluded.name: Hogan and Luce Campground
excluded.why: RVs and motorhomes no longer than 20 ft

excluded.name: Middle Fork of the Powder River Campground
excluded.why: the last 17 miles are two-track dirt

excluded.name: North Boulder Lake Campground
excluded.why: 5 primitive sites; only an aggregator line about the road, nothing on site size

excluded.name: Outlaw Cave Campground
excluded.why: the last miles to the canyon rim are rough; high-clearance 4WD recommended
